scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a dragon — but which one?!
We have the blue egg, the red egg, and the golden egg. Pick your favorite!
Think you know? The countdown is on — three, two, one!
The blue egg cracks open and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack, no dragon here!
The red egg pops open and… it's a tiny fluffy bunny! So cute, but no dragon!
The golden egg shakes and rumbles and… a baby dragon flies out! You got it!
Nice work! Level two is coming tomorrow — can you beat it? See you then!
